Metadata.title: Akkuea Land | City Builder on Stellar
Metadata.description: Build, own, and trade virtual land parcels backed by real-world assets on the Stellar blockchain.

PilotCta.bannerText: This is a simulation. Ready to see real yield from real property?

Home.title: Akkuea Land Grid Panel
Home.subtitle: Test and interact with property panels across all four dynamic blockchain ownership states.
Home.unownedStateDescription: Click the Amber tile. Connect wallet to purchase from the treasury.
Home.ownedStateDescription: Click the Green tile. Upgrading building level or creating a sale listing triggers the signature simulator.
Home.listedStateDescription: Click the Purple tile. If wallet is connected, purchase is available.
Home.signatureGuardDescription: at the top. Notice that all transaction buttons are strictly hidden behind the wallet connect guard!
Home.noPropertySelectedDescription: Click on any land tile in the grid to slide in the real-time interaction property panel.

welcome.title: Welcome to Akkuea Land
welcome.description1: Explore and buy virtual properties in a dynamic, live city grid. Earn steady rental income in real-time as the city thrives.
welcome.description2: Your Stellar wallet has been set up securely through Pollar. You don't need any prior blockchain experience or fees to play.

claimLand.title: Get your starter LAND
claimLand.description: LAND is the premium utility token of Akkuea Land. Reclaim 1,000 LAND from our testnet faucet for free to fund your very first property claim.
claimLand.transactionFailed: Transaction failed. Please make sure you have internet access.

claimProperty.title: Claim your first property
claimProperty.description: Tap on any highlighted treasury tile on the grid below. It is yours completely free as a starting bonus!
claimProperty.celebrationDescription: You successfully claimed your first property on Stellar! We are loading the real-time city map for you now...

Map.pageDescription: Explore the 20x20 Akkuea City grid. Discover, select, and trade virtual land parcels.
Map.heading: City Map

Marketplace.heading: Marketplace
Marketplace.description: Listed land parcels and active auctions will appear here.
